ValidationRule.description: Mobile# Or Email is Mandatory for ML Lead
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'MLCRM_Lead', Text(Status) != 'Expired', NOT(CONTAINS( $User.Username,$Label.UnicaIntegrationUserName)), NOT(CONTAINS( $User.Username,$Label.AdobeIntegrationUserName)), OR( NOT(ISNEW()), AND(ISNEW(),TEXT(Lead_Originator__c) == 'MLCRM') ), ISBLANK(FinServ__RelatedAccount__c), ISBLANK(MobilePhone), ISBLANK(Email) )
